name: solitaire
description: Klondike solitaire in a pane, styled after the Microsoft Solitaire Collection: felt with a gradient, cards with shadows, block-letter ranks and pips, three difficulty levels, deals checked solvable by the built-in solver, hints, a solver that shows the solution, rescue (undo until solvable), auto-solve, demo, win animation. English or German.
